$comment: Authored (WP-F). Known contrast shortfalls, each with a reason and the ratio measured when recorded (per mode). tokens:check fails when a listed pair gets worse, when an unlisted pair fails, and when a listed pair no longer fails (delete the entry). Ratios are WCAG 2.x after alpha compositing.

Tecton export design value: black at 50% on the white top-nav band (light mode) is 4.0:1. The tecton-astryx derivation (white text on black) passed but left primary text at 1.2:1 on the band, so the export was adopted (D-001). Large nav labels only; owner accepted (D-013).

Inherited design shortfall (2.9:1 in dark mode). Mitigation is component-level, as in tecton-astryx: the table header re-points its icons to --color-text-secondary (icon-on-table-header-mitigated in this matrix, passing 3:1).

Inherited from the Tecton design (divider medium, 2.2:1 in both modes; tecton-astryx pins it with a test). Allowed for decorative separation only (D-013 Q-05): a component whose border is the sole indicator of a control boundary or of state (WCAG 1.4.11) must use a border token that measures 3:1 or more on its surface, e.g. --tecton-color-divider-strong (3.1:1, in this matrix). Component review enforces this.

Tecton export dark value (graphite.onDark.220 #57515c): 2.2-2.4:1. The light value passes (3.1:1). The field label, value and focus state also identify the control (WCAG 1.4.11 applies to a sole indicator); components may use --tecton-color-divider-strong for a stronger rule; owner accepted (D-013).

Tecton table fills are darker than the page in light mode (header graphite.140, hover/active/footer washes): the hot-pink ring measures 2.3-3.0:1 there. No second focus hue exists in Tecton (D-005). The Table work package draws the documented double ring (--tecton-color-focus-inner) on these cells or re-points --focus-outline-color locally (styling.md 8).
